title: (Pwn2Own) Zoom Heap based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Zoom Clients. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the processing of encrypted messages. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current user.
